subjects.description: One entry per daily brief; each has its own channel list.

name.description: Display name of the brief. Also used (sanitized) as the report folder name.

id.description: YouTube channel ID (starts with UC). Find it in the channel page source as externalId, or paste the channel URL into the Morning Brief app.

vault_path.description: Absolute path to your markdown folder / Obsidian vault.

report_dir.description: Subfolder inside vault_path where briefs are written (one sub-subfolder per subject).

lookback_hours.description: How far back each run searches for new videos. Dedup makes overlapping windows safe.

min_duration_seconds.description: Videos shorter than this are skipped (filters out Shorts).

transcript_defer_hours.description: How long to wait for captions before summarizing from the description instead.

max_transcript_chars.description: Transcripts are truncated to this length before summarization.

claude_model.description: Model passed to `claude -p --model` (e.g. sonnet, opus, haiku).
